channel.title: RealHunt: new homes
channel.description: New homes on RealHunt, checked by a person and scored from 70 to 98.

item.title: €189,000 · Three-bedroom village house with terrace and Serra da Lousã views near Penacova
item.description: Paradela da Cortiça, Penacova, Coimbra. 95 m². RealHunt score 80. A neat three-storey village house in Paradela da Cortiça with an open view of the Serra da Lousã. It keeps its original doors, wooden ceilings and floors and granite details, with aluminium windows. The main floor has a kitchen with open fireplace and dining area, a living room with balcony, three bedrooms and a full bathroom, opening onto a terrace and garden. Below are a garage and a workshop, above a large attic, and outside a shed with barbecue and wood oven. Shops are 5 to 10 minutes away, several river beaches 20 to 30 minutes, and Coimbra about 45 minutes. Energy class F.

item.title: €170,000 · Renovated village house with an A3 energy rating near Killala harbour, Mayo
item.description: Killala, County Mayo. 95 m². RealHunt score 83. A recently renovated two-storey house on Gore Street in the centre of Killala, a short stroll from the harbour on Killala Bay. About 95 m²: entrance hall, a 6.5 m sitting room, kitchen and dining room with a new fitted kitchen and a guest WC downstairs, and one very large double bedroom with a shower room upstairs. The agent says it is finished to a high standard. Rare for an older house, it has a BER of A3, with oil central heating and all mains services. There is a paved courtyard at the back. Ballina is about 13 km away. Only one bedroom.

item.title: €195,000 · Furnished 1850 stone house with courtyard and mountain views in Milea, West Mani
item.description: Milea, West Mani, Messinia. 132 m². RealHunt score 84. A two-level stone house in traditional Mani style, first built around 1850 and rebuilt in 2003, in the quiet hill village of Milea. About 132 m2 including the thick stone walls, on a 233 m2 plot with a stone courtyard and a covered terrace looking over the mountains. The ground floor has a living room with fireplace, kitchen and WC, and the upper floor a second living room, bathroom and bedroom, reached inside or by an outside stair. Two air conditioning units, and it is sold fully furnished and ready to use. The agency fee of 3% plus VAT is extra.

item.title: €150,300 · Recently built three-bed house three blocks from the beach in La Paloma, Rocha
item.description: La Paloma, Rocha. 90 m². RealHunt score 82. Asking US$165,000 (about €150,300). A recently built single-storey house, 1 to 8 years old and listed in excellent condition, on a quiet street in the Playa Serena area of La Paloma, about 300 m from the beach. It has a bright open living, dining and kitchen space, three bedrooms (one en suite) and a second full bathroom. Outside there is a timber deck with a covered barbecue, a fully fenced 510 m² garden among pines and a parking space. Sold directly by the owner, and the photos show a clean, modern finish throughout.

item.title: €177,000 · Two-bedroom corner duplex with mountain-view terrace in Alcalá de la Selva
item.description: Alcalá de la Selva, Teruel. 112 m². RealHunt score 80. A corner duplex built in 2009 in Alcalá de la Selva, a mountain village in Teruel about 10 minutes from the Valdelinares ski slopes and an hour from Valencia. It has 112 m2 built, 95 m2 usable, with two bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, a bathroom with bath, a guest toilet, a fitted kitchen and a living room with a fireplace insert. The east-facing terrace has wide views of the pine-covered hills. A lift, a covered parking space and a storage room are included. The photos show a modern, well-kept interior, ready to move into. Community fees are not stated in the advert.

item.title: €130,000 · Renovated 1790 townhouse with garden and hill views in Ruota, near Lucca
item.description: Ruota, Capannori, Tuscany. 95 m². RealHunt score 82. A detached stone townhouse from 1790 in the small hill village of Ruota, completely renovated in 2015, with views over the hills and the Compitese plain. About 95 m2 on three floors: open kitchen and living room with a big fireplace, then a double and a twin bedroom, a study corner and a shower room with skylight, and a cellar room with a rock wall that opens onto the enclosed private garden. No condominium fees, an owned parking space in front of the garden, and papers in order according to the advert. Lucca is 20 to 30 minutes away and Pisa airport about 45.

item.title: €180,300 · Timber-ceiling house with fireplace and barbecue under 100 m from the sea, Playa Grande
item.description: Playa Grande, Piriápolis, Maldonado. 115 m². RealHunt score 85. Asking US$198,000 (about €180,300). A traditional house of 115 m² in Playa Grande, next to Piriápolis, less than 100 m from the coast road and the sea. Inside are timber beam ceilings and terracotta floors, a large living room with a wood fire, a dining room, a separate kitchen, two bedrooms (one en suite), two full bathrooms and an attic room upstairs. Outside are front and back gardens, a large covered barbecue area and a garage. The house is fully independent but held under a horizontal property title on a plot of almost 400 m² for its exclusive use.

item.title: €115,000 · Renovated stone house with terrace in medieval Arcidosso, Monte Amiata
item.description: Arcidosso, Grosseto, Tuscany. 100 m². RealHunt score 80. A fully renovated house with its own front door in the medieval centre of Arcidosso, a lively hill town on the slopes of Monte Amiata in southern Tuscany. Inside are exposed stone walls, beamed ceilings and terracotta floors: a large living room with kitchen corner and fireplace, a study, a bathroom and a usable terrace on the lower level, then a double bedroom, a small second bedroom and a second bathroom above. Heating runs on mains gas, and it is sold furnished and ready to live in. About 100 m2 for 115,000 euros.

item.title: €195,300 · Five-bed stone and brick house with a Lake Chapala view terrace in El Tepehuaje
item.description: El Tepehuaje, Tuxcueca, Jalisco. 245 m². RealHunt score 88. Asking MX$4,080,000 (about €195,300). An 8-year-old house of 245 m² on a 514 m² plot in the village of El Tepehuaje, on the south shore of Lake Chapala and about an hour from Guadalajara. It has arched windows, stone walls and brick vaulted ceilings, a living and dining room with a double-sided fireplace and a kitchen with a breakfast bar. There are five bedrooms, each with its own full bathroom; the main one has a lake view, a sitting area and a jacuzzi. A large roof terrace looks over the lake, and there is a patio with a fire pit, a barbecue area and parking for two cars.

item.title: €180,000 · Renovated detached stone house with courtyard in Andriani, Messinia
item.description: Andriani, Messinia. 148 m². RealHunt score 89. A detached stone house of 148 m2 in the village of Andriani, freshly renovated and set on a plot of about 500 m2. The photos show new timber floors, new wooden windows and doors, a fitted white kitchen and modern tiled bathrooms. Downstairs is a large living and dining area with a bathroom, and upstairs two big bedrooms, two more bathrooms and a balcony with country views. Two entrances, one onto a paved courtyard and garden by the kitchen, the other onto private parking. The seaside village of Agios Andreas is 7 km away and Kalamata about 50 km. Agency fee is extra.

item.title: €140,000 · Two-bedroom house with fenced garden and river views near Marvão, Alentejo
item.description: Ponte Velha, Marvão, Portalegre. 70 m². RealHunt score 79. A bright 70 m2 house in the quiet Ponte Velha area below Marvão, with river and mountain views, on a fully fenced 476 m2 plot with grapevines, olive trees and a persimmon tree. Two double bedrooms, a living room with a pellet stove, a kitchen with gas oven and a new water heater, and one bathroom, dated but clean. Two annexes could become a separate small unit. The advert puts the river pool and cafes of Portagem 5 minutes away, Marvão and Castelo de Vide 15 minutes, and says the licence and land registry papers are ready. The portal files it under Pernes; the text places it near Marvão.

item.title: €149,000 · Renovated old stone house with private courtyard in Neapoli, east Crete
item.description: Neapoli, Lasithi, Crete. 93 m². RealHunt score 86. An old stone house on a quiet cul de sac a few minutes on foot from the centre of Neapoli, a lively Cretan market town with shops, banks and a weekly produce market. The owners renovated it to a high standard: double glazing with shutters and insect screens, oil central heating, air conditioning, solar hot water and a fitted kitchen with dishwasher. A gated, tiled courtyard leads to the living room, kitchen and shower room, with a double bedroom, cloakroom and sun terrace above, plus a loft that could become a second bedroom. About 93 m2. Agios Nikolaos and its beaches are about 11 km away.

item.title: €176,300 · Two-storey house with a mountain-view balcony and estate pool in Santa Fe de Antioquia
item.description: Santa Fe de Antioquia, Antioquia. 150 m². RealHunt score 86. Asking COP 650,000,000 (about €176,300). A 150 m² two-storey house on a 170 m² plot in a gated country estate at Santa Fe de Antioquia, the colonial town in the warm valley northwest of Medellín. Downstairs is an open living and dining room with an island kitchen, opening onto a covered terrace and a lawn garden. Upstairs are three air-conditioned bedrooms under timber-beamed ceilings, the main one with a balcony looking straight at the mountains, and two bathrooms. Parking for two cars. The estate has 24-hour gatehouse security, CCTV, a pool, a steam room and a social hall. Fees: administration COP 550,000 a month (about €150).

item.title: €190,700 · Four-bed heritage house with tin ceilings and flower gardens in downtown Summerside
item.description: Summerside, Prince Edward Island. 156 m². RealHunt score 82. Asking C$299,900 (about €190,700). A historic house of 156 m² in Summerside's Downtown Heritage District, close to the shops, restaurants and waterfront. It keeps its hardwood and softwood floors, Douglas fir trim, decorative tin ceilings and built-in cabinets. The main floor has a living room with a propane stove, a formal dining room, a large eat-in kitchen, laundry, two bedrooms and a family room with a cathedral ceiling, a pellet stove and garden doors to the rear deck. Upstairs are two more bedrooms and a bathroom with a claw-foot tub. Mature trees and flower gardens surround it. Property tax C$2,218 a year.

item.title: €125,400 · Modern three-bedroom house from 2015 with a double-height living room in Yakumo, Matsue
item.description: Yakumo-cho Hiyoshi, Matsue, Shimane. 96 m². RealHunt score 77. Asking ¥21,990,000 (about €125,400). A two-storey wooden house finished in January 2015 in Yakumo-cho Hiyoshi, a quiet residential area in the green hills south of Matsue, the castle city of Shimane. 96 m² with a bright living, dining and kitchen room of about 20 tatami under a double-height ceiling, a modern fitted kitchen, a bathroom with a window and three bedrooms upstairs, on a 168 m² freehold plot with a lawn garden and parking for three cars. The house is empty and sold directly by the owning company, which is refreshing it now. JR Iya station is 7.2 km away.

item.title: €230,000 · Sea-view two-bed end-of-terrace house above the Atlantic in Kilkieran, Connemara
item.description: Kilkieran, Connemara, County Galway. 102 m². RealHunt score 80. An end-of-terrace house in a small, tidy development on a raised site above the Atlantic near Kilkieran village in Connemara, with wide sea views. About 102 m²: a living room built around a natural stone fireplace with a stove and a door to the garden, a large kitchen and dining room, two double bedrooms (the main one with a vaulted ceiling, Juliet balcony and en suite) and a family bathroom. The village has a shop, school, church and a bar and restaurant; Clifden is about 44 km and Galway about 70 km. Photos show it furnished, clean and bright. BER C3.

item.title: €249,000 · Renovated house with sauna, plunge pool and guest studio 800 m from Lake Balaton
item.description: Balatonlelle, Somogy (Lake Balaton). 108 m². RealHunt score 84. A house on a 660 m² corner plot in a quiet part of Balatonlelle, 800 m from the free Virág beach on Lake Balaton. About 108 m²: living room, kitchen-diner and shower room downstairs, and an open-plan upstairs with sleeping, work and sitting areas, a second bathroom and two balconies. Renovated in 1998 with a new roof and attic, wiring, plumbing, windows and insulation; chimney redone in 2020. Gas central heating, two tiled stoves and air conditioning. A separate building holds a 40 m² double garage, a cellar and a studio with kitchen, bathroom and balcony. Finnish sauna and plunge pool in the garden.

item.title: €142,500 · Japanese-style one-floor house from 2016 on a big corner plot near Kaike, Yonago
item.description: Kaike-Shinden, Yonago, Tottori. 140 m². RealHunt score 81. Asking ¥25,000,000 (about €142,500). A wooden house finished in October 2016 in Kaike-Shinden, Yonago, a short drive from the Kaike hot-spring resort and its beach on the Sea of Japan. The advert describes it as a one-floor home without stairs: 140 m² with a dining kitchen, a western-style room and three tatami rooms, including a 10-mat room with a tokonoma alcove, plus a bathroom with a window, two toilets and a sunny wooden veranda corridor. All-electric. It stands on a 510 m² freehold corner plot with roads on three sides, parking for three or more cars and a separate 33 m² storage garage. Empty, handover at once.

item.title: €130,900 · Maintained brick house with a heat pump and garden in Lomnička near Plesná, Cheb
item.description: Lomnička, Plesná, Karlovy Vary region. 120 m². RealHunt score 85. Asking 3,182,000 CZK (about €130,900). A maintained brick house in a quiet part of Lomnička, a village belonging to the town of Plesná in the Cheb district. About 120 m² of living space on a 378 m² plot: a large bright living room and a separate kitchen downstairs, a bedroom upstairs, a bathroom and a separate WC, plus a covered terrace, cellar, attic and a wooden shed in the garden. It is sold furnished and the advert says it can be lived in without major work. Heating is by a heat pump; mains water. The rooms are dated but clean.

item.title: €125,000 · Renovated stone house inside the walls of Gaglietole Castle, Umbria
item.description: Gaglietole, Collazzone, Umbria. 125 m². RealHunt score 82. A stone house within the walls of the small medieval castle of Gaglietole, near Collazzone in the hills between Perugia and Todi, recently renovated and described as in excellent condition. About 125 m2: a large living area, an eat-in kitchen with a wood-burning stove, a double and a single bedroom, a study area and two bathrooms, plus an attic reached by a pull-down stair. The bedroom windows look over open hills. A single garage nearby is included. Roughly 1,000 euros per m2 for a move-in home in a historic Umbrian setting, a few minutes from shops and services.

item.title: €214,900 · Renovated four-bedroom house with new roof, kitchen and baths in Sandusky, Lake Erie
item.description: Sandusky, Ohio. 139 m². RealHunt score 88. Asking US$236,000 (about €214,900). A 1920 house of 139 m² in the Lake Erie town of Sandusky, redone and ready to move into. The work list includes new siding, windows, roof, gutters, drywall, paint, flooring and lighting, an updated electrical system and partly updated plumbing. The kitchen has new cabinets, granite worktops and new appliances, and both bathrooms are new with glass walk-in showers. There are four bedrooms, one with extra attic storage behind the closet. Outside is a large composite deck, a big back garden and a storage shed. Property tax US$1,128 a year, no HOA.

item.title: €150,300 · Brick chalet with three bedrooms one block from the beach in La Aguada, La Paloma
item.description: La Aguada, La Paloma, Rocha. 100 m². RealHunt score 85. Asking US$165,000 (about €150,300). A solidly built single-storey chalet of exposed brick in La Aguada, next to La Paloma, one block from the beach, less than 100 m from the sea and with a sea view listed in the advert. 100 m² on a 450 m² corner plot facing two streets, with gardens front and back. A bright living and dining room with big windows is partly open to the kitchen, and a corridor leads to three bedrooms with built-in shelves and two refurbished shower rooms with glass screens. There is a garage, a tiled patio and a covered barbecue. Listed in good condition, built more than 30 years ago.

item.title: €220,000 · Ground-floor two-bed flat with an en suite, a walk from Tramore beach, Waterford
item.description: Tramore, County Waterford. 76 m². RealHunt score 77. A ground-floor flat in the Pebble Beach development in Tramore, within walking distance of the beach and promenade, set among lawns with views of the bay from the estate. About 76 m²: a very large open-plan living, dining and kitchen room with a fireplace, two double bedrooms (the main one with an en suite shower room) and a second bathroom. Photos show it freshly painted, clean and ready to use, with patio doors onto the green. BER B. Waterford city is reached by regular buses. Management charge for 2026: €1,025 a year.

item.title: €203,500 · Sea-view four-bed flat on the 16th floor one block from Marbella beach, Cartagena
item.description: Marbella, Cartagena, Bolívar. 132 m². RealHunt score 85. Asking COP 750,000,000 (about €203,500). A 132 m² flat on the 16th floor of a 9 to 15 year old tower in Marbella, one block from the beach and close to the historic centre. A long glass balcony looks over the sea, and the open living room has an island kitchen with dark stone worktops. There are four bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, the main one with a dressing room, four bathrooms, four air-conditioning units, two parking spaces and a storeroom. The building has a pool, gym, games room and sports court. Fees: building administration COP 750,000 a month (about €200).

item.title: €245,000 · Country house renovated 2020-2025 with 2 ha of land in Kozjak near Maribor
item.description: Kozjak nad Pesnico, Kungota. 112 m². RealHunt score 83. A house from 1965 fully renovated between 2020 and 2025, on a 21,508 m² sloping estate of meadows and woods in the Kozjak hills, under 15 km from Maribor. About 112 m²: entrance hall, kitchen open to a living and dining room with a terrace, two bedrooms, a new bathroom, a WC and a laundry, plus a basement boiler and storage room. New PVC windows (2020), facade insulation, insulated metal roof, underfloor heating and a solid-fuel stove. Carport and summer kitchen. The photos show bright new interiors and wide views. An older house and outbuilding on the land are dilapidated.

item.title: €104,000 · Ground-floor flat with a 225 m2 south-facing garden in Savignone, Liguria
item.description: Savignone, Genoa, Liguria. 75 m². RealHunt score 78. A private sale of a 75 m2 flat with its own entrance in a nine-unit building in Savignone, a green village in the hills behind Genoa, 600 m from the main square. The best part is a south-facing garden of 225 m2 with a vine pergola and mountain views, plus a covered 14 m2 veranda. Inside are a large living room, a kitchenette, a double bedroom, a bathroom and a second room for a bedroom or study. Described as in excellent condition, with its own heating, and mostly furnished. The seller says management fees are low but gives no figure.

item.title: €123,400 · Updated five-bedroom house with a bathroom for every bedroom in Twillingate, Newfoundland
item.description: Twillingate, Newfoundland. 203 m². RealHunt score 90. Asking C$194,000 (about €123,400), under €610 per m². A roomy 203 m² house in the outport town of Twillingate, in Newfoundland's Iceberg Alley, known for iceberg and whale watching. It has had major renovations: complete rewiring with 200-amp service, electric heat throughout, a mini-split heat pump and an updated kitchen with new white cabinets. There are five bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, plus a half bath, a living room and two dining areas. It was run as a bed and breakfast and is sold fully furnished. Outside are a lawn, a 14 x 20 ft storage shed and a traditional root cellar. Property tax C$1,200 a year.

item.title: €182,100 · Fully restored 1940s cottage with a deep front porch on a corner lot in Hot Springs
item.description: Hot Springs, Arkansas. 117 m². RealHunt score 89. Asking US$199,900 (about €182,100). A 1940 house on a corner lot under tall oak trees, fully restored with all new plumbing and wiring. It keeps its hardwood floors and deep covered front porch, and the living room, dining room and kitchen flow into one another. The kitchen is new, with white cabinets, granite worktops, open shelving and stainless steel appliances. The main bedroom has its own bathroom with a tiled walk-in shower, and there is a second bedroom and a guest bathroom. The back garden is fully fenced and there is a one-car carport. Washer, dryer and fridge are included. Property tax US$820 a year, no HOA.

item.title: €227,700 · Wooded raised ranch with cedar ceilings across the road from Lake Huron, Alpena
item.description: Alpena, Michigan. 172 m². RealHunt score 90. Asking US$250,000 (about €227,700). A 2006 raised ranch of 172 m² on nearly half an acre of woodland, with Lake Huron and a sandy swimming beach just across the road. The open living, dining and kitchen area sits under a cathedral ceiling of white cedar boards, with a wood stove, red oak cabinets and a large kitchen island. There are two bedrooms and two full bathrooms, with room to add a third bedroom. It has in-floor heating, an insulated foundation and a very large heated garage for cars, a boat or a workshop. Property tax US$1,420 a year. HOA US$150 a year for road upkeep and snow clearing.

item.title: €161,000 · Well-kept three-bed semi-detached house with solar panels in Enniskillen, Fermanagh
item.description: Enniskillen, County Fermanagh (Northern Ireland). 107 m². RealHunt score 83. Asking £140,000 (about €161,000). A three-bedroom semi-detached house in a quiet area of Enniskillen, Co. Fermanagh, well maintained inside and out. About 107 m²: a fitted kitchen with dining space, utility area and downstairs WC, a bright living room with an open fire, and three bedrooms (two doubles) with a family bathroom upstairs. It has solar panels, insulated dry-lining on the outside walls, a new condensing boiler and some new radiators. Stone-walled front garden and an enclosed rear patio with a covered seating area and a large shed. Rates £652 a year.

item.title: €195,000 · Restored stone courtyard house with a sea-view roof terrace in Gytheio
item.description: Gytheio, Laconia. 85 m². RealHunt score 82. A traditional stone house of 85 m2 on a quiet car-free lane in the old town of Gytheio, a short walk from the harbour front, on a 127 m2 walled plot. Restored with original stone paving, wooden floors and old doors kept. A stone-floored living room opens to the courtyard, where a newly renovated kitchen and an outdoor shower sit under a lemon tree. Upstairs are a double and a single bedroom and a modern shower room, and a raised terrace looks over the rooftops to the sea. Sold turnkey; Mavrovouni beach is 5 minutes by car.

item.title: €210,000 · Renovated Luberon village house with vaulted cellar in Saint-Martin-de-Castillon
item.description: Saint-Martin-de-Castillon, Vaucluse, Provence. 90 m². RealHunt score 78. A fully renovated village house of about 90 m2 in the Luberon hills, priced near the low end of the portal's local sales range per m2. The fitted kitchen opens onto a vaulted stone cellar and a small terrace, the bright living room has a wood stove and open views, and there are two bedrooms, a modern shower room, two toilets and a utility room. The photos show beamed ceilings and new finishes throughout. Shops and the village swimming pool are about 400 metres away. Asking 210,000 euros.

item.title: €175,000 · Single-storey 138 m² home with garden below the mountains in Zupci, near Bar
item.description: Zupci, Bar. 138 m². RealHunt score 84. A single-storey home of 138 m² in Zupci, a quiet village in the hills behind the town of Bar, with steep mountains right behind it. Two bedrooms, a bathroom, a large open living and dining room with a fitted kitchen, a terrace and a balcony, with air conditioning, heating and parking. The photos show bright, tidy, furnished rooms and a lawned garden. Asking €175,000, about €1,270/m². The advert files it as an apartment, so ask whether the house and garden are shared.

item.title: €205,000 · Stone house with a private riverbank and outbuildings in Vendeuvre, Normandy
item.description: Vendeuvre, Calvados, Normandy. 100 m². RealHunt score 76. A 99.5 m2 stone house on an enclosed 1,545 m2 plot that runs down to a river with private banks. Downstairs are a living room with a wood-burning insert, a fitted kitchen and a bathroom, and upstairs three bedrooms of 13 to 15 m2. Double glazing, a recent air-to-water heat pump and solar panels are already in place, and the outbuildings add about 150 m2 with two garages, a workshop and a carport. The advert says some finishing and refreshing work is still to plan. Saint-Pierre-sur-Dives is a 7-minute drive. Property tax 647 euros a year.

item.title: €195,000 · Renovated village house with its own pool in Benijófar, Costa Blanca
item.description: Benijófar, Alicante. 66 m². RealHunt score 76. A single-storey house in the centre of Benijófar, a small town in the Vega Baja inland from the southern Costa Blanca, renovated and described as move-in ready. About 66 m2, south facing, with an open living room and kitchen, two double bedrooms with high ceilings and wooden beams, and a modern shower room. The private walled yard holds a pool of about 18 m2 and a dining terrace, which is rare at this price. Shops, schools and health services are in the town. Community fees and yearly tax are not stated in the advert.

item.title: €216,600 · Colonial house with a pool and garden in Barrio de Santiago, Mérida centre
item.description: Mérida, Yucatán. 160 m². RealHunt score 86. Asking MX$4,450,000 (about €216,600) for Casa Ya'axche', a single-storey colonial house of 160 m² on a 279 m² plot in Barrio de Santiago, one of the old neighbourhoods of central Mérida. It keeps its stone walls, high ceilings and patterned cement tile floors. The living room, kitchen and dining area open onto a long swimming pool, and there are inner gardens with mature trees, a barbecue area and terrace. Both bedrooms have their own bathroom, air conditioning and fans, and there is a third bathroom by the patio, a covered parking space and a laundry room. The photos show it renovated and furnished.

item.title: €124,000 · Freshly painted three-bedroom house with ocean views in Hillsburn, Nova Scotia
item.description: Hillsburn, Nova Scotia. 106 m². RealHunt score 88. Asking C$194,900 (about €124,000) for a three-bedroom house of about 106 m² on a hillside plot in Hillsburn, a shore village on the Bay of Fundy about 10 minutes from Annapolis Royal. The aerial photos show the sea just below. It is move-in ready, with a freshly painted exterior and new windows. The main floor has a large country kitchen with an island, a dining room, a living room with a pellet stove and a sea view, and a big bathroom with soaker tub and walk-in shower. Upstairs are the three bedrooms and a storage room. Outside are raised garden beds, a shed, a deck and a viewing platform.

item.title: €199,000 · Garden-level flat with a south terrace steps from the beach on the Flensburg Fjord
item.description: Wassersleben, Harrislee, Schleswig-Holstein. 60 m². RealHunt score 77. A three-room flat of about 60 m² a few steps from the beach and the Flensburg Fjord. The living room with open kitchen has floor-to-ceiling windows onto a south-facing terrace that looks over a well kept communal garden. Two further rooms work as bedrooms or an office, and the bathroom has a tub. Electric outside blinds on every window, a step-free basement storage room for bikes and beach gear, and a parking space in front. It is empty and available soon. District heating, energy class C. Monthly building fees are not given in the advert.

item.title: €165,200 · Fully remodelled three-bedroom house in a gated complex with pool, Santa Marta
item.description: Santa Marta, Magdalena. 120 m². RealHunt score 86. Asking COP 590,000,000 (about €165,200) for a two-storey house of about 120 m² in a gated residential complex in Rodadero Reservado, the quiet area north of El Rodadero beach in Santa Marta on the Caribbean coast. It has just been fully remodelled in a modern style: a new kitchen with stone-look worktops and gas hob, glossy tiled floors, a steel-railed staircase and new bathrooms with glass showers. There are three bedrooms, the main one with its own bathroom and dressing area, a separate study and a guest toilet. Balconies look onto green hills, and the complex has a large shared pool. Maintenance fee not stated.

item.title: €170,000 · Furnished two-bedroom flat with sea views in Nea Fokea, Kassandra, Halkidiki
item.description: Nea Fokea, Kassandra, Halkidiki. 60 m². RealHunt score 80. A 60 m2 first-floor flat in a two-storey building in Nea Fokea, a seaside village on the Kassandra peninsula of Halkidiki. The advert says the sea can be seen from the windows and that the owners will leave the furniture. Open living room with a modern fitted kitchen and wood stove, two bedrooms and a shower room, with windows on two sides and a covered balcony with awnings. Air conditioning, oil central heating with radiators and solar water heating. The photos show a well-kept home ready to use.
